entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return my VeloBand. It's broken.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse tracking is not working at all, and it won't sync the data to my phone. The thing is basically defective.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely check your return options. Do you have your order number handy?
Just use my email. It's quick. j.doe@example.com.
Thank you. Pulling that up now... one moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 24th. Let me just confirm the policy for you.
Look, is it a yes or no? I don't have a lot of time.
Yes, I understand. And yes, it looks like you're well within the return period. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Great. So you're sending a shipping label?
Absolutely. I have just approved your return. I'm generating a pre-paid shipping label and sending it to the email on file right now. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes.
And the refund will be for the full amount?
That's correct. Once our warehouse receives the defective unit, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. That typically takes 3 to 5 business days after we get it back.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
